name: iphone-sync
description: Local Wi-Fi Photo & Video Sync from iPhone to Mac and Windows

scripts.dev:windows: cd apps/windows && npm run build && npm start
scripts.test:windows: cd packages/SyncCore.Windows && npm test && cd ../../apps/windows && npm test
scripts.build:windows: cd packages/SyncCore.Windows && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../../apps/windows && npm ci && npm run build && npm run dist
scripts.lint:swift: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project iPhoneSync.xcodeproj -scheme iPhoneSyncMac -destination 'platform=macOS' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
